name: Tyler Hoffman
headline: 23, overnight home-care aide, Columbus, Ohio
description: Tyler dropped out of a computer science program in Columbus last spring and now works as an overnight home-care aide for a disabled veteran. He took the job on a whim after a friend backed out, and he has already rearranged his shifts twice to start a weekend phlebotomy certificate. His parents still cover his car and phone, which lets him abandon projects as soon as they bore him.
